# Residual momentum · trend quality · crash gating — Phase 0

*Generated by `scripts/residual_momentum_phase0.py`. Judge every IC against ~0. BH-FDR(10%) runs across the WHOLE candidate grid, not per-row.*

Panel **deep** · 1503 names · 2002-01-02..2026-08-04 · 269 monthly rebalances (2004-02-27..2026-06-30) · beta 252d (shrink 0.66) · forward 21d.

**Windows tested:** `w3_1`, `w6_1`, `w12_1`, `w6_ex5`. `w12_ex21` collapsed onto `w12_1` — "12−1 months" and "12 months excluding the last 21 days" are the same construction (form 252 / skip 21), so the five requested windows are FOUR distinct tests.

**Factor legs live:** NONE — market + sector only (the deep panel has no factor history; legs are reported absent, never imputed to zero).

## C. Crash gating

Conditions live: `breadth_rev`, `extension`, `loser_run`, `mom_vol`, `rebound`, `xs_corr`.
Mean exposure 0.611 over 2002-02-04..2026-08-04 — Sharpe is scale-invariant, so holding less on average cannot by itself move the Sharpe column; any lift there is TIMING.

| variant | Sharpe | cum % | max DD % | skew | DSR | verdict | Sharpe CI | P(SR>0) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|---|---|--:|
| ungated | 0.1 | 5.7 | -64.1 | -1.42 | 0.0438 | FAILS multiple-testing haircut (DSR<0.90) | [-0.33, 0.11, 0.57] | 0.673 |
| crash-gated | 0.32 | 73.7 | -28.6 | -1.63 | 0.2465 | FAILS multiple-testing haircut (DSR<0.90) | [-0.09, 0.33, 0.79] | 0.937 |
| vol-target (Barroso) | 0.29 | 67.6 | -35.7 | -0.47 | 0.2097 | FAILS multiple-testing haircut (DSR<0.90) | [-0.13, 0.3, 0.75] | 0.913 |
| gate x vol-target | 0.48 | 80.0 | -13.7 | -0.35 | 0.5411 | FAILS multiple-testing haircut (DSR<0.90) | [0.07, 0.49, 0.93] | 0.987 |

The gate has to beat `vol-target (Barroso)`, not just `ungated` — one-line vol scaling is the cheap baseline six conditions must justify.

**Per-era — is this one episode?** A crash gate can post a great full-sample number off a single event and nothing else. Every block is printed, losers included.

| era | days | SR ungated | SR gated | SR vol-tgt | SR both | maxDD ungated % | maxDD both % |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 2004–2010 | 1511 | -0.46 | 0.06 | -0.17 | 0.26 | -62.2 | -12.4 |
| 2010–2016 | 1510 | 0.53 | 0.76 | 0.66 | 0.86 | -16.0 | -6.3 |
| 2016–2022 | 1511 | -0.06 | 0.02 | 0.16 | 0.27 | -41.7 | -11.3 |
| 2022–2026 | 1088 | 0.75 | 0.77 | 0.57 | 0.62 | -21.5 | -9.7 |

`gate x vol-target` beats `ungated` on Sharpe in **3 of 4** eras and on max drawdown in **4 of 4**. (Eras where the sleeve held no positions at all — too few names to form quintiles early in the deep panel — are excluded rather than padding the denominator with blocks no gate could have affected.)

---

**Multiple testing.** 38 candidates logged to the Trial Ledger for family `residual_momentum_phase0`; the Deflated Sharpe reads its n from there rather than a caller-chosen literal.

**Standing prior.** `resid_accel` (residual acceleration) was pre-registered and KILLED in the earlier residual-alpha work (deep-panel IC −0.012, t −2.7) and is carried here as a DIAGNOSTIC only — it is excluded from the quality composite by construction. Re-promoting it needs a fresh pre-registered gate.
